prompt:
Use the reference images for the world and all characters, keeping their exact designs: the single big round dark iron hotpot (no dividers) with glossy red chili oil broth, the small rustic ceramic oil dish with golden sesame oil, the wooden table and warm lantern-lit Chongqing restaurant; and the characters: the cooked fatty beef roll, the flat dark velvety tripe sheet, the duck blood cube and the tofu cube with cilantro leaves on their heads, the dried chili characters, the Sichuan peppercorn characters, the garlic cloves and the scallion pieces — all with googly eyes (white eyeballs, black pupils), small toothless mouths, tiny arms and legs of their own material, photorealistic textures. New shot: the finale group photo, vertical 9:16, camera about 30 degrees above, wide framing so the whole hotpot (about 90%, rim and both handles) is visible in the upper-middle and the full oil dish in the lower front. Everyone faces the camera together like posing for a group photo: in the hotpot the tripe, duck blood, tofu, chilies and peppercorns stand up in the broth; in the oil dish the cooked beef roll sits in the center front, surrounded by the garlic cloves and scallions. All of them raise their tiny arms high in celebration with big happy satisfied smiles, eyes wide open and sparkling, looking straight into the camera. Gentle steam rising from the hotpot behind them. Warm tungsten light, glistening red and golden oil highlights, cute food-character animation in a photorealistic style, appetizing, film grain. No comic motion lines or symbols, no humans, no human hands, no text, no logos.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
